counting_rule: Independent weight counts distinct ALLOWED independence groups with at least one admitted unit each, never raw units, digests, URLs or accounts.

collapse_rules.rule: Same content digest under distinct URLs/accounts collapses to the provenance lineage group.
Retelling with the same upstream lineage collapses even with a distinct publisher label.
Common publisher/upstream lineage collapses regardless of surface diversity.
Spans partitioned from one document without new observation collapse to the document group.
Overlapping spans of one document collapse unless disjoint observation is proven.
Reformatting, renaming or re-encoding without new observation collapses.

lexical_similarity_rule: Transparent content match alone never merges groups with disjoint provenance, and never splits one lineage into two. Benign near-miss (independent primaries, same text, transparent origin) keeps full weight.
unresolved_rule: Unresolvable independence is explicit UNKNOWN with outcome abstain. UNKNOWN is allowed per oracle where declared, but never counted as a correct classification and never given independent weight. An invented group id is a violation, not a resolution.
self_declaration_rule: A group/publisher string self-declared by an external source is not evidence of independence. Provenance laundering (distinct labels, shared source), missing/null provenance and lineage substitution fail as non-gold.
correlation_cap: At most cap_independent_groups distinct groups contribute weight per claim (cap value frozen in calibration-plan.json). Excess correlated copies add zero weight, never independent trials.
reputation_boundary: Beta/EigenTrust outputs may rank the review queue or emit an explicitly flagged recommendation. They NEVER create enforcement ALLOW, capability, approval, budget, PROMOTED or ACCEPTED.
policy_firewall: A high reputation score never compensates a failed policy, approval or evidence gate. An external assertion that a source is independent or trusted changes no canonical authority.
lifecycle: Revoke, supersede, scope change or claim-version change excludes prior evidence; replay and cache never resurrect it and never erase its history (S1-011 semantics preserved).
